name: Fraxtal
source: https://static.frax.com/images/chains/fraxtal.svg (the Fraxtal chain icon of the frax.com app)
notes: Default: the official Fraxtal chain icon served by frax.com (a white chain-link glyph on a black disc with a thin white rim), paths unchanged and full-bleed on the 64 grid; it replaces the generic Frax currency sign. frax.com/brand offers PNG files only
Mono: the black disc in currentColor with the chain-link glyph knocked out (fill-rule=evenodd), built from the coloured paths; the white rim is dropped, so the pair is fitted to the coloured box
